operations.title: Rung-3 sub-subleading triangle dual-engine exact-check suite: 31/31 sympy + 31/31 Rust/Symbolica, zero-mismatch diff, no rung-2 regression

The sub-subleading soft factor S(2) closes kinematically with no conservation law: the P-to-J escalation terminates at rung 2; the Campiglia-Laddha Ward bridge verifies at the D_z^4 grade with a declared fold; the rung-3 memory corner is open

operations.body: Rung three is closed to a verdict; ledger entry 1096. (1) SOFT CORNER: S(2) is gauge invariant per leg from J antisymmetry alone — the checker proves each per-leg variation vanishes identically with all Sigma-constraints removed (anti-test: removing P and J conservation changes nothing), while the rung-2-grade contraction Lambda.q.J stays nonzero without Sigma J=0. The P->J escalation terminates; rung-3 closure is kinematic, no conservation law is the input. (2) WARD CORNER (grounded: Campiglia-Laddha 1605.09094, charges of O(r) divergence-free large diffeos beyond generalized BMS): under the declared fold (weights (-1,0,1,2), uniqueness witnessed) the regular part of D_z^4 S(2)- vanishes in all four operator channels and the electric/magnetic doubling is exact. Named residual: the computed delta^2 coefficient is uniformly HALF the printed CL16 one (-3pi/Ek vs -6pi/Ek) — same delta^2-normalization drift family as the rung-2 KLPS scaffold. (3) MEMORY CORNER: open by grounding, not by failed check — Nichols CM memory is rung-2 grade; a rung-3 observable would be a double retarded-time-integral, first-moment, D_z^4-grade observable (CL16 (17) structure verified), but naming it is a typed open item. (4) Cross-rung ladder exact: D_z^2,int^0 -> D_z^3,int^1 -> D_z^4,int^2; one fold recursion reproduces the rung-2 fold. Verification: 31/31 sympy + 31/31 Rust/Symbolica (new bin subsubleading.rs), zero-mismatch programmatic diff, rung-2 suites re-run with no regression (53/53). New grounded sources: cl1605.09094, cl1502.02318, nichols1807.08767, fpr2111.15607. Artifacts under research/strominger/: checkers/subsubleading_triangle_exact_checks.py, results JSONs, subsubleading-triangle-{conventions,source-boundary}.md. Ledger 1096 via sequence claim seqclaim-68fffb4df7f91a874900663e. Next natural question: name the rung-3 memory observable (the H-mem candidate) or prove none exists at that grade.
